name: Bless
effect: +1 to the party's attacks and saves for one fight.

name: Command
effect: One word a target must obey for a round: halt, flee, drop, kneel. Will save resists.

name: Cure Light Wounds
effect: Restores 1d8 HP and ends Poisoned. Reverses to Cause, 1d8 on a touch.

name: Detect Evil
effect: Sense Chaotic creatures and cursed things within 60 ft for 6 turns.

name: Detect Magic
effect: Sense magic within 30 ft for 6 turns.

name: Light
effect: 30 ft of light for 6 turns. Reverses to Darkness.

name: Protection from Evil
effect: +2 AC and saves against Chaotic creatures for one fight.

name: Purify Food and Water
effect: Makes a day's spoiled rations or fouled water safe.

name: Remove Fear
effect: Ends Frightened on an ally, or grants +4 to resist it for one fight.

name: Resist Cold
effect: An ally is immune to natural cold and takes half from cold attacks, one fight.

name: Sanctuary
effect: For 1d4 rounds enemies need a Will save to attack you; you may not attack in turn.

name: Find Traps
effect: Traps within 30 ft glow to your sight for 6 turns.

name: Hold Person
effect: Up to 3 people, Body save or Paralyzed 1d4 rounds.

name: Know Alignment
effect: Read one creature's alignment.

name: Resist Fire
effect: An ally is immune to natural fire and takes half from fire attacks, one fight.

name: Silence
effect: 15 ft radius, no sound or casting, 6 turns.

name: Slow Poison
effect: Halts a Poisoned condition for an hour, buying time for a cure.

name: Speak with Animals
effect: Talk with natural beasts for 6 turns; they may answer or aid.

name: Spiritual Hammer
effect: A floating hammer of force fights for you at your attack bonus, 1d4, one fight.

name: Animate Dead
effect: Raise HD of skeletons or zombies up to your Level to serve until destroyed. A Chaotic act.
components: bone dust and a black pearl worth 100 GP, consumed

name: Continual Light
effect: A permanent bright light, or blind a creature's eyes until dispelled (Body save).
components: a firefly or a pinch of phosphorus

name: Cure Disease
effect: Cures one disease, including a mummy's rot. Reverses to Cause Disease.

name: Cure Serious Wounds
effect: Restores 2d8 HP. Reverses to Cause Serious Wounds.

name: Dispel Magic
effect: Ends ongoing spells up to your Level in a 20 ft area, or counters one as it is cast.

name: Locate Object
effect: Point toward a known object within a mile for 6 turns.

name: Prayer
effect: The party gains +1 and enemies take -1 to attacks and saves for one fight.

name: Remove Curse
effect: Ends one curse, Charmed, or a cursed item's grip. Reverses to Bestow Curse.

name: Burning Hands
effect: A fan of flame: 1d3 per Level in a 10 ft cone, Dodge save for half.

name: Charm Person
effect: Will save or Charmed.

name: Comprehend Languages
effect: Read or understand one unknown tongue or script for 6 turns.
components: a pinch of soot and salt

name: Detect Magic
effect: Sense magic within 30 ft for 6 turns.

name: Enlarge
effect: Grow a creature half again, +1 damage and a step of STR, or shrink it (Body save). One fight.

name: Feather Fall
effect: You and those near you drift safely down from any fall for a round.

name: Find Familiar
effect: Call a small animal bound to you: it shares your senses and lends 1 HP per Level, but its death wounds you.
components: incense and rare herbs worth 25 GP, burned

name: Hold Portal
effect: A door stays shut for 6 turns.

name: Light
effect: 30 ft of light for 6 turns.

name: Magic Missile
effect: 1d4+1 damage, never misses. One more dart at Levels 3 and 5.

name: Read Magic
effect: Decipher arcane script and scrolls so you can cast or copy them.

name: Shield
effect: +4 AC for one fight.

name: Shocking Grasp
effect: Your next touch this round delivers 1d8 plus your Level in lightning.

name: Sleep
effect: 2d4 HD of creatures of 4 HD or less fall Asleep, no save.

name: Spider Climb
effect: Climb walls and ceilings like a spider for 6 turns.

name: Unseen Servant
effect: An invisible force fetches, carries, and does simple tasks for an hour.

name: Continual Light
effect: A permanent bright light, or blind a creature (Body save).
components: a firefly or a pinch of phosphorus

name: Darkness 15 ft
effect: A 15 ft globe of dark that no sight in the dark pierces, 6 turns.

name: Detect Invisibility
effect: See invisible, hidden, and phased things within 30 ft for 6 turns.

name: ESP
effect: Hear the surface thoughts of creatures within 60 ft (Will save to shield a mind).

name: Forget
effect: Up to four creatures forget the last few minutes (Will save).

name: Invisibility
effect: Unseen until you attack or cast.

name: Knock
effect: Opens one lock or stuck door.

name: Levitate
effect: Rise and sink in the air by will for 6 turns. No sideways push.

name: Mirror Image
effect: 1d4 copies of you, each absorbing one hit meant for you.

name: Ray of Enfeeblement
effect: A ray saps a target: -2 to its attacks and damage (Body save), one fight.

name: Scare
effect: A target of 4 HD or less is Frightened (Will save).

name: Stinking Cloud
effect: A 20 ft cloud: Body save or retch helplessly for 1d4 rounds.

name: Strength
effect: An ally gains a step of STR, +1 to attack and damage, for one fight.

name: Web
effect: 20 ft, Dodge save or stuck 1d4 turns. Burns away in a round.

name: Blink
effect: You flicker out and in: attacks against you at -2, and you may step 10 ft each round.

name: Clairvoyance
effect: See a known or nearby place at a distance for 6 turns.

name: Dispel Magic
effect: Ends ongoing spells up to your Level in a 20 ft area.

name: Fireball
effect: 5d6 in a 20 ft burst, Dodge save for half.
components: a pinch of bat guano and sulfur

name: Flame Arrow
effect: Touched arrows or bolts burn for +1d6 fire, one per Level, one fight.

name: Fly
effect: You fly for 6 turns.

name: Gust of Wind
effect: A blast of wind scatters missiles, clouds, and small flyers in a line.

name: Haste
effect: Up to one creature per Level acts twice or moves double, one fight.

name: Hold Person
effect: Up to four people, Body save or Paralyzed 1d4 rounds.

name: Invisibility 10 ft
effect: You and all within 10 ft turn invisible until one attacks or casts.

name: Lightning Bolt
effect: 5d6 in a 60 ft line, Dodge save for half.
components: a scrap of fur and a glass rod

name: Phantasmal Force
effect: A silent illusion up to a 20 ft cube. A viewer who disbelieves sees through it (Will save).

name: Protection from Normal Missiles
effect: Nonmagical arrows, bolts, and stones cannot hit you for one fight.

name: Slow
effect: Up to one creature per Level acts at half (Dodge save), one fight. Undoes Haste.

name: Suggestion
effect: A reasonable command the target follows (Will save) until done or the day ends.

name: Water Breathing
effect: You and those near you breathe water for a day.

name: Entangle
effect: Grass and root seize everyone in a Near patch. A Dodge save or held fast, with a new save each round to tear free. One fight.

name: Faerie Fire
effect: Ring a target in pale light for one fight. Attacks against it gain +1 and it cannot hide.

name: Speak with Animals
effect: Talk with natural beasts for 6 turns. They answer as their nature allows and may grant a small favor on a good reaction.

name: Pass Without Trace
effect: You and your band leave no track or scent for 6 turns, +4 to shake pursuit in the wild.

name: Shillelagh
effect: A staff or club becomes a magic weapon, +1 to hit and 1d8 damage, for one fight.

name: Goodberry
effect: 1d6 berries, each heals 1 HP and feeds a traveler for a day. They spoil at next dawn.

name: Barkskin
effect: A target's skin turns to bark: +2 AC for 6 turns.

name: Produce Flame
effect: A flame sits in your palm for 6 turns. Hurl it to Near as an attack for 1d6 fire, and it sets tinder alight.

name: Heat Metal
effect: Metal a target wears turns scalding for 1d4 rounds: 1d4 a round until dropped. Great mass or cold iron resists.

name: Warp Wood
effect: Bend and split wooden items within Near, one per two Levels: a spear shaft, a bow, a plank, a door.

name: Hold Animal
effect: Freeze up to 1d4 natural beasts. Each rolls a Will save; the held are Helpless for 1d4 rounds.

name: Call Lightning
effect: Under a storm sky, call a bolt once a round for 6 turns: Near, 1d6 per two Levels, Dodge for half. Needs a storm overhead.

name: Plant Growth
effect: Brush and briar burst across a wide space, near impassable. Lasts until cut back.

name: Protection from Fire
effect: A target ignores ordinary fire and halves magical fire for 6 turns, until it soaks 12 damage.

name: Summon Swarm
effect: A swarm of biting insects fills a Near space for one fight. Those within take 1 a round and act at -2.

name: Animal Friendship
effect: Over a day of feeding and care, win a wild beast as a loyal companion. Keep one such beast per two Levels.

name: Detect Snares and Pits
effect: Sense deadfalls, pits, and crude or natural traps, and unsafe footing, within 40 ft for 6 turns.

name: Invisibility to Animals
effect: Natural beasts cannot see, hear, or smell the warded creature for 6 turns, unless it attacks.

name: Locate Animals or Plants
effect: Sense the nearest of a named beast or plant within a mile, and its direction, for 6 turns.

name: Predict Weather
effect: Know the coming day's weather for a few miles around, as sure as the season allows.

name: Purify Water
effect: Make a barrel of foul water or a day's spoiled rations clean and safe, or foul them.

name: Charm Mammal
effect: A warm-blooded beast takes you for a friend. Will save resists; a failed one lasts until you harm it or a day passes.

name: Create Water
effect: Call clean water from the air, enough for a party and its mounts for a day.

name: Feign Death
effect: A willing creature falls into a deathlike trance for 6 turns, stiff and cold, taking half from blows and immune to drain while under.

name: Fire Trap
effect: Ward a box, door, or body. The next to open it unbidden takes 1d4 + Level fire, Dodge for half. Holds until sprung.

name: Obscuring Mist
effect: A damp fog fills a Near space for 6 turns. Past 5 ft, sight and missiles fail.

name: Speak with Plants
effect: For 6 turns, question the local growth. It answers simply and may part a path or tangle a foe.

name: Trip
effect: A vine, root, or your staff whips out: a moving target in reach saves Dodge or falls prone.

name: Cure Disease
effect: A touch ends one disease or rot. Reverses to Cause, a wasting sickness on a failed Body save.

name: Neutralize Poison
effect: Draw the venom from one creature or dose: ends Poisoned, or renders a poison inert. Can instead foul good food.

name: Pyrotechnics
effect: Spend a nearby fire as blinding fireworks (watchers Dodge or blind a round) or a choking smoke cloud.

name: Snare
effect: Weave a cord, vine, or root into a near-invisible trap. The first to tread it is bound or yanked up, Dodge negates. Holds until sprung.

name: Stone Shape
effect: Mold a block of stone no larger than you like clay: a rough door, a niche, a crude span. One shaping.

name: Tree
effect: Take the seeming of a tree for up to a Day, aware and unharmed by ordinary notice. End it at will.

name: Water Breathing
effect: Up to two creatures breathe water for 6 turns, or you breathe air underwater the same span.

name: Hold Plant
effect: Shamblers, vine horrors, and like growth within Near stop still. Each rolls a Will save; the held are Helpless for 1d4 rounds.
